research.thaumaturgicinfusion.aspect_eff: Each aspect behaves differently once it is bound into a block. Some change a single property of the block, others give it a whole new purpose. Their effects must be learned one by one.

Known effects:
Leaping (Aer): Aer phial, 16 Aer. Players standing on or next to the block get Jump Boost (100 ticks, every 2 s).
Venom (Venenum): Aversio phial with spider eye, 32 Aversio. Players standing on or next to the block are poisoned (100 ticks, every 4 s).
Padding (Pannus): Praemunio phial with any wool, 8 Praemunio. Pads all fall damage of any entity landing on it.
Warding (Tutamen): Praemunio phial, 8 Praemunio. Hardness +50 and more resistant to explosions.
Brittleness (Perfodio): Terra phial with iron pickaxe, 16 Terra. Block hardness and resistance are halved.
Hunger (Fames): Desiderium phial with rotten flesh, 32 Desiderium. Every 2.5 s, players within 15 blocks have a 50% chance to lose a point of food.
Mending (Sano): Victus phial with glistering melon slice, 8 Victus. Every 2.5 s, fed players within 15 blocks have a 50% chance to heal half a heart.
Hellfire (Infernus): Ignis phial with blaze powder, 32 Ignis. Sets living entities touching or walking on it on fire (8 s).
Binding (Vinculum): Vinculum phial, 32 Vinculum. Mobs in the three blocks above it cannot move.
Deterrence (Bestia): Bestia phial, 32 Bestia. Stops hostile mobs spawning on top of it.
Glamour (Praecantatio): Praecantatio phial, 16 Praecantatio. Sparkles drift around the block.
Displacement (Alienis): Alienis phial, 8 Alienis. Teleports entities standing on it to a random safe spot within 10 blocks.
Greed (Lucrum): Desiderium phial with gold nugget, 32 Desiderium. Pulls item entities within 10 blocks towards itself.
Conveyance (Motus): Motus phial, 32 Motus. Pushes entities on top in the direction it was placed.
Volatility (Perditio): Perditio phial with gunpowder, 32 Perditio. Block is prone to exploding (1 in 20 when touched, power 4).
Stormcall (Tempestas): Aer phial with lightning rod, 8 Aer. In storms, lightning strikes the block now and then.
Flight (Volatus): Volatus phial, 32 Volatus. Players up to 10 blocks above it can fly; each stacked block adds 10 more.
Switching (Machina): Machina phial, 32 Machina. A redstone signal switches the block's other effects off.
Lore (Cognitio): Cognitio phial with book, 8 Cognitio. Counts as a bookcase for enchanting tables.
Slickness (Gelum): Gelum phial, 8 Gelum. Slippery like ice (0.98).
Eternal Flame (Ignis): Ignis phial, 8 Ignis. Acts like netherrack: fire on top burns forever.
Stability (Ordo): Ordo phial, 32 Ordo. Stabilises nearby infusion altars.
Tilth (Messis): Herba phial with wheat seeds, 8 Herba. Block is a disguised farmland.
Gloom (Mortuus): Mortuus phial, 32 Mortuus. Hostile mobs spawn on top in the dark.
Fertility (Victus): Victus phial, 32 Victus. Animals spawn on top in the light.
Purity (Vitium): Vitium phial, 8 Vitium. Clears taint blocks next to it.
Passage (Iter): Motus phial with ender pearl, 32 Motus. Link two Iter blocks with a wand; stepping on one moves you to the other.
Wellspring (Aqua): Aqua phial, 8 Aqua. Block is a disguised infinite water source.
Hollow (Vacuos): Vacuos phial, 32 Vacuos. Block becomes a disguised inventory.
Exchange (Permutatio): Permutatio phial, 32 Permutatio. Link an inventory with a wand; the block then acts as an extension of it.
Ooze (Limus): Aqua phial with slime ball, 32 Aqua. Block acts like still water (swimmable).
Radiance (Lux): Lux phial, 8 Lux. Emits light like a torch (14).
Charge (Potentia): Potentia phial, 32 Potentia. Gives off a full redstone signal.
Ghosting (Spiritus): Spiritus phial, 32 Spiritus. Looks solid but has no collision.
Clarity (Vitreus): Vitreus phial, 16 Vitreus. Light passes through the block.
Halving (Arbor): Herba phial with any logs, 16 Herba. Block becomes a half slab.
Veiling (Sensus): Sensus phial, 32 Sensus. Only visible to players wearing goggles of revealing.
Nightfall (Tenebrae): Tenebrae phial, 32 Tenebrae. Only visible and solid in the dark.
Guise (Superbia): Humanus phial with gold ingot, 32 Humanus. Right-click with a block to disguise it as that block.

Iter and Exchange are linked by sneak-using a wand on one block, then on the other block or inventory.
research.thaumaturgicinfusion.block_infu: The Thaumonomicon says that a feather infused into a block makes the block as light as the feather. If that is true, an aspect on its own might be infused into a block, and the block would take on the aspect's nature.

Block infusion fuses an aspect into a block. Put the block on the central pedestal of an infusion altar and a phial of the aspect on a pedestal around it; some aspects also need a second item beside the phial to settle which effect they take. The altar draws the essentia from nearby jars as usual and gives the block back carrying the effect. A block can carry several effects: infuse it again with another phial. When the block is placed the effect works where it stands, and breaking it drops the block with its effects intact.

The Infusion Core, infused from an arcane pedestal, steadies the altar twice as well as a candle or skull, which the costlier effects will need. Wearing Goggles of Revealing shows which effects a block carries.
research.thaumaturgicinfusion.essentia_b: Essentia poured into an arcane mould sets into a glowing stone of its own colour.

Four phials of one aspect on an arcane workbench make an Essentia Block of that aspect, which glows with the aspect's colour. Four blocks make four Essentia Bricks, and four bricks make four Chiseled Essentia Blocks.
